confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregator and blog estimates (Expatistan, Holiday Extras, expat guides), several undated, plus a national menu del dia survey. Cocktail and wine are weakly sourced. The wine glass is set from the beer relationship, not a direct price. Beer serving size is unclear. Meal prices were converted from EUR at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR, which was not sourced from this search. Accommodation anchors (hostel and hotel) are holistic model estimates with no live listings checked. The FX observation is the latest RBA figure I could confirm, dated 2026-03-20, not a value for the 2026-10-16 generation date; I did not locate a newer RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Alicante-specific aggregator estimates and the Spanish national menu del dia average. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Spanish coastal city in peak July season.
